claims: The rendered page now reports validated ledger 108047474 at 2026-11-01 14:58 UTC, superseding the earlier 00:27 UTC page snapshot.
It reports two November 1 EscrowFinish releases totaling 1 billion XRP at 00:00:02 UTC.
It reports zero re-escrow at the pinned ledger and 64.2% re-escrow across the preceding 12 monthly releases.
It identifies both owner accounts and links to each transaction.
sources.publisher_methodology_claim: The page says it reads rippled JSON-RPC from s1.ripple.com with xrplcluster.com fallback, uses account_objects and account_tx at a single pinned validated ledger, and counts Ripple-owned escrow objects once by ledger index.
limitations: The publisher's RPC methodology was not independently reproduced in this execution.
The linked livenet.xrpl.org transaction pages returned JavaScript-only content.
The earlier 00:27 and 02:31 ledger observations are historical snapshots, not current state; the new 14:58 page resolves the page-freshness conflict without validating the earlier raw RPC response.
A tracker 'net out of escrow' value does not establish circulating supply, tradable float, external transfer or sale.

claims: XRP on the XRP network is listed in phase one of withdrawals.
Phase one was scheduled for 06:00-09:00 UTC and assets would become available progressively.
Binance reports approximately 95% aggregate replenishment, up from 90%.
Binance reports BTC, ETH, USDT, BNB, SOL, USDC, XRP, USD1, RLUSD and ZEC balances fully backed 100%.
The remaining 5% is described as less-liquid assets outside the top ten, with market and OTC acquisition continuing.
limitations: The announcement does not disclose XRP-specific purchases or quantities.
The 95% figure is aggregate coverage, not a disclosed cash-spend total.
The announcement says to check the withdrawal page/network status; it does not itself prove a successful XRP withdrawal.

claims: Reports that, as of 05:00 Eastern on November 1 (10:00 UTC), Binance said withdrawals had been restored for BTC, ETH, BNB, XRP, Base, DOGE and Optimism.
Reports phased restoration and the FBI's attribution of the overall incident to TraderTraitor.
limitations: The report quotes Binance's X status; it is not a direct test withdrawal or a live XRP network-status API response.
It does not prove all users or all XRP withdrawals were processing without delays.

claims: Before the phase-one window, Reuters reported Binance's planned phased reopening and approximately 95% aggregate replenishment.
limitations: This is a pre-window report and is not evidence of XRP service status after the window.

source_independence_notes: XRP Insights and Whale Alert are separate data publishers; the former claims direct rippled JSON-RPC ingestion, while Whale Alert independently renders one transaction's sender and receiver.
Whale Alert is not a substitute for raw validated XRPL transaction metadata.
Binance Update #4 is a primary company claim; CBS/AFP reports Binance's later X status but does not test the service.
No market feature is admitted from these sources in this revision.
